Dicky Best, that "young" veteran, actually walked away with the 880 Yards handicap, and in no uncertain manner, as his time proved.
Baumann, off scratch, second; and Dicky Best, third. Charlie Cook was also in the final, but did not display his customary "dash."
Botwright, off 2 yds., was second, with Dicky Best, off 19 yds., third. The 1 Mile handicap was won by a newcomer, J.

Included in the programme was a “Grandfathers” 100 yards race, put on by the Veterans' A.C., and among the runners was our own Dicky Best and George Still, who are still going strong.
